  | push : Nat -> Instr

def compile : Expr -> List Instr
  | .lit n => [.push n]
  | .add l r => compile l ++ compile r ++ [.plus]
def run : List Instr -> List Nat -> Option (List Nat)
  | [], s => some s
  | .push n :: code, s => run code (n :: s)
  | .plus :: code, a :: b :: s => run code ((b + a) :: s)
  | .plus :: _, _ => none

lemma aux (e : Expr) (s : List Nat) : run (compile e) s = some (eval e :: s) := by
  cases e
  | lit m => 
    calc
      run (compile (.lit m)) s = run ([.push m]) s := rfl
      _ = run [] (m :: s) := rfl
      _ = some (m :: s) := rfl
      _ = some (eval (.lit m) :: s) := rfl
  | add l r =>
    generalize_with s
    rw [concat_assoc, concat_assoc]
    have ih1 : run (compile l) (eval r :: s) = some (eval l :: eval r :: s) := aux l (eval r :: s)
    have ih2 : run (compile r) s = some (eval r :: s) := aux r s
    rw [ih1, ih2]
    simp only [compile.add]
    unfold push
    simp_all [Option.map_some]

theorem compiler_correct (e : Expr) : run (compile e) [] = some [eval e] := by
  exact aux e []
